job.title: Warehouse Associates
job.description:
Now hiring Warehouse Associates in Phillipsburg, NJ, with shift options available throughout the week and pay rates ranging from $17.50 to $19.50 per hour. Additional perks include weekly pay, comprehensive benefits starting from day one, career growth opportunities, and eligibility for our 401(k) plan.


Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, including telemedicine
  • Unlimited telemedicine and urgent care visits for you and your family
  • Group term life insurance for employees, spouses, and children
  • Short-term disability coverage
  • Prescription drug discount program
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program
  • Career development and skill-building opportunities
  • 401(k) participation eligibility


About the Role
As a Warehouse Associate, you'll be responsible for loading and unloading shipments, verifying and reporting damages, preparing shipments, and maintaining warehouse safety and cleanliness. You'll also assist with general warehouse tasks, ensuring all procedures are followed precisely. Flexibility is key, as rotating 8- to 10-hour shifts may be required.


Pay Rate: $17.50 — overtime opportunities available
Shift Times: Varying shifts, including days and evenings, seven days a week


Key Responsibilities

  • Load and unload shipments, confirming documentation
  • Verify, document, and report damages and discrepancies
  • Prepare, palletize, and measure shipments
  • Manually wrap pallets with shrink wrap
  • Accurately pick, pull, and pack orders
  • Follow safety and security procedures
  • Assist with warehouse cleaning and maintenance
  • Report service issues promptly
  • Perform additional duties as assigned, including working rotating shifts


Key Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of warehouse or similar experience
  • Ability to lift up to 49 pounds
  • Proficiency with carts, hand trucks, and warehouse equipment
  • Ability to climb stairs if applicable
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

job.description:
Now hiring QPS/RELAY Team Leader – 1st Shift to support warehouse operations; this role is on-site in Phillipsburg, NJ, pays $23.00/hour. Schedule Monday to Sunday 6 am to 3:30pm. If you’re a hands-on warehouse leader who can keep daily activity moving safely, accurately, and efficiently—this is a great opportunity to step into a lead role while still staying active on the floor.

As a Warehouse Team Leader, you’ll assist the Senior Supervisor with directing and supervising day-to-day warehouse operations.   • Monday to Sunday 6 am to 3:30 pm

  • Assist the Senior Supervisor in directing and supervising warehouse operations
  • Implement work schedules, assign work effectively, and ensure tasks are completed properly
  • Lead and coordinate inbound unloading/stacking and outbound picking/staging
  • Promote efficient and safe operation of product handling equipment
  • Maintain product location system and support strong space utilization/warehouse consolidation
  • Complete required reports accurately and on time
  • Lead, instruct, and assist warehouse staff; ensure adherence to company policies
  • Monitor inbound and/or outbound activities
  • Support inventory control and space utilization efforts
  • Perform daily warehouse functions (storing, packing, picking, shipping, receiving) as required

  • High School Diploma/equivalency or significant relevant work experience

  • Approximately 3 years of department/industry experience
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in warehouse, distribution, and/or transportation
  • Ability to demonstrate leadership and guide lower grade subordinate staff
  • Knowledge of material handling, warehouse operations, and transportation
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time

job.title: Supervisor QPS/SKYPOD area- 2ND SHIFT
job.description:
Now hiring a Warehouse Supervisor (QPS/SKYPOD Area) – 2nd Shift for a warehouse operation located in Phillipsburg NJ. Schedule Monday to Saturday 1-930PM and Sundays 8AM to 430PM and a starting pay rate of $23-$28 based on experience. In this role, you’ll lead day-to-day warehouse operations on your assigned shift—directing teams, protecting inventory accuracy, and driving safe, compliant performance. This opportunity starts through the agency, with the right candidate converting to a permanent client hire after 90 days.


Benefits

  • 90-day path to permanent hire with the client (based on performance)
  • Support from Integrity Staffing throughout your assignment


About the Role

The Warehouse Supervisor oversees warehouse operations on an assigned shift by assigning, directing, and monitoring warehouse staff to ensure strong customer service, quality, compliance, safety, and positive employee relations.


Pay Rate: up to $28 based on experience


Shift Time

  • Monday to Saturday 1PM to 9:30PM and Sunday 8 AM to 4:30 PM


Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and direct warehouse staff using sound warehouse operating principles and procedures

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable government regulations
  • Monitor team performance to support timely pick-ups, deliveries, and transfers with excellent customer service and zero damages/losses
  • Maintain inventory controls and records to support inventory accuracy
  • Conduct cycle counts on a predetermined schedule
  • Document, record, and report inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Manager in a timely manner
  • Train warehouse staff on effective operations, safety, and security
  • Maintain a positive employee relations environment aligned with company policies
  • Prepare and submit daily/weekly paperwork on time
  • Recommend daily staffing levels based on volume
  • Perform other duties as required


Key Requirements

  • Associate degree in business or related field

  • 2–5 years of distribution/warehouse operations experience, including prior team lead or supervisory experience
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-up
  • Computer skills including AS-400, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Lotus Notes
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills with a professional, positive, motivated demeanor
  • Bilingual English/Spanish (speaking/reading/writing) is a plus

job.title: Special Project- Packaging Associate
job.description:
Now Hiring Special Project – Packaging Associate in Macungie, PA, with multiple shift options (1st, 2nd, and 3rd shift) paying up to $18.00. This is a special project assignment (5–7 weeks) with a targeted start date of 10/09/2026, supporting pharmaceutical packaging operations where quality, accuracy, and consistency matter every day.


Benefits


  • Competitive weekly pay
  • Multiple shift options to fit your schedule
  • Opportunity to gain experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
  • Support from Integrity Staffing throughout your assignment


About the Role

As a Line/Packaging Associate, you’ll perform hands-on packaging and inspection tasks—placing pharmaceutical product into containers, checking quality, and supporting line operations to meet quantity and compliance requirements. This role is ideal for detail-oriented individuals who are comfortable working on their feet in an active production setting.


Pay Rate:


  • $16.00/hr - $18.00/hr


Available Shift Times


  • 1st Shift: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM
  • 2nd Shift: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM
  • 3rd Shift: Sunday–Thursday, 11:00 PM–7:00 AM


Key Responsibilities


  • Place packaged pharmaceutical materials into containers while working from a machine, conveyor, or stationary table
  • Inspect units for quality as they are packaged
  • Use sorting equipment or hand-sorting devices as needed (may include operating a toggle machine)
  • Code stamp packages, apply labels, assemble shipper/container displays, and insert materials as required
  • Count materials and assist with rework, returned materials, or rejected materials as assigned
  • Perform other duties as needed to support production goals


Key Requirements

  • Ability to read a limited number of two- and three-syllable English words and recognize differences between words and number series
  • Ability to print and speak English
  • Basic math skills: add/subtract two-digit numbers; multiply/divide with 10s and 100s
  • Ability to follow simple one- or two-step instructions and use common sense judgment in standardized situations
  • Ability to stand, walk, and reach regularly during the shift; occasional lifting up to 10 lbs
  • Comfort working around moving mechanical parts; moderate noise environment

Dress Code

  • Tops: White shirt
  • Bottoms: White pants or black pants (t-shirts, pants, sweatpants, joggers, leggings, jeans, scrubs permitted)
  • No rips/tears; no shorts
  • Footwear: Comfortable, clean, any color

job.title: Asociados de Almacen
job.description:
Estamos buscando Asociados de Almacén para trabajar en Flexport en Phillipsburg, NJ. ¡Gana hasta $22.75 por hora* en un entorno dinámico y divertido, con una de las empresas líderes mundiales en logística y cadena de suministro!

EVENTO DE CONTRATACION DE PUERTAS ABIERTAS
Fecha: Del lunes 21 de septiembre al sábado 26 de septiembre
Horario: Lun-Vie: 9:00 a. m. - 7:00 p. m. | Sáb: 9:00 a. m. - 1:00 p. m.
Dirección del evento: Flexport, 3000 Rand Blvd, Phillipsburg, NJ 08865


Beneficios

  • Pago semanal competitivo
  • Planes médicos, dentales, de visión y medicamentos recetados
  • Seguro de vida
  • Seguro por discapacidad a corto plazo
  • Servicios de telesalud
  • Programa de Asistencia al Empleado (EAP)


Descripción del Puesto
Como Asociado de Almacén, desempeñarás un papel fundamental para garantizar la operación segura y eficiente del almacén. Tus responsabilidades incluirán recibir mercancía, preparar y enviar pedidos, cargar camiones y mantener un ambiente de trabajo limpio y organizado.

Salario: Hasta $22.75 por hora
*La tarifa de pago es temporal por temporada hasta el 2 de enero.

Turnos Disponibles (Día)

  • Domingo a Miércoles | 7:00 am - 5:30 pm o 6:30 am - 5:00 pm
  • Miércoles a Sábado | 7:00 am – 5:30 pm o 6:30 pm - 5:00 pm
  • Lunes, Martes, Jueves, Viernes | 7:00 am - 5:30pm o 6:30pm - 5:00 am

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Recibir, escanear y acomodar inventario
  • Empacar y enviar pedidos de acuerdo con las especificaciones del cliente
  • Cargar cajas en los camiones para su envío
  • Mantener registros precisos del inventario
  • Etiquetar y organizar la mercancía
  • Operar el equipo de almacén de manera segura
  • Resolver problemas operativos básicos
  • Mantener el almacén limpio y organizado
  • Cumplir con todas las normas y procedimientos de seguridad
  • Reportar inmediatamente cualquier riesgo o incidente de seguridad
  • Comunicarse de manera efectiva con los demás miembros del equipo
  • Requisitos
  • Mínimo 1 año de experiencia en almacén o en un puesto similar
  • Excelentes habilidades de organización y administración del tiempo
  • Excelente asistencia y puntualidad
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo
  • Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y trabajar de manera segura

Requisitos Físicos

  • Levantar hasta 49 libras
  • Empujar carros utilitarios de hasta 60 libras
  • Utilizar carros, plataformas y carretillas manuales
  • Subir y bajar escaleras cuando sea necesario
  • Trabajar en entrepisos (mezzanine) de hasta 40 pies de altura, cuando aplique

  • 2nd shift

  • Inspect incoming components and bulk products visually and physically
  • Document and evaluate inspection results for release decisions

  • Experience in quality inspection or a similar role preferred
  • Attention to detail and strong documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Flexibility to work on either 1st or 2nd shifts
